title: Approval of Agreement Nos. 47985A, 47985B, and 47985C, for Professional
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Agreement Nos. 47985A, 47985B, and 47985C, for Professional
  Services for the Eastern Sierra Water Management Program with Formation
  Environmental, LLC; Geosyntec Consultants, Inc.; and Stantec Consulting
  Services, Inc. The proposed Agreement Nos. 47985A, 47985B, and 47985C
  will provide professional services for tasks related to water management in
  the Eastern Sierra for a term of five years and a cumulative amount not to
  exceed $8,600,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
